title: Keep gateway trust memory unchanged when durable commit fails
description: Gateway::admit_gateway currently mutates TrustStore via verify_tofu before checking persistence availability or committing store/floor. Ephemeral use returns an error after mutation, and an I/O failure leaves runtime trust newer than durable state. Stage the mutation in a cloned store, atomically persist it and its floor, then swap it into the gateway; add failure tests.
close_reason: Implemented: Gateway::admit_gateway (rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:960) clones the TrustStore into a staged candidate, runs verify_tofu on the clone, persists store+floor via the trust persistence paths, and only then swaps into runtime state — ephemeral-use errors and I/O failures leave runtime trust unchanged, exactly as prescribed. Full lichen-gateway suite green this session.
